Its main weakness is that the evidence partly extrapolates from Ni-based alloys and the experiment should directly verify SRO (e.g., diffuse scattering or atom-probe analysis), but A provides no cited support and makes a questionable assumption of coherent Y2O3–refractory interfaces.
